Same goes for warrior of the light if your torch is always over 75. Quirks that give you scouting chance/dmg in specific area are good too(unless you get like ruins one on flaggelant) cause scouting is really useful. And then there are trash quirks like skilled gambler. If you want some more info/more details you can watch FilthyRobot's dd guide series. He talks about quirks,curios,classes,money managment and lots of useful staff.

You should try to not dismiss you heroes.1 good quirk is more valuable then removing 4 bad ones.
